title: Audio memory read callback
summary: Recovered cdecl callback at 0x55dd50: unsigned bounded memcpy from audio owner data plus cursor, then post-copy cursor increment. Original registration and adjacent seek code establish the partial layout.
test_description: Differential original-reference tests over lengths 0..128, every in-range cursor and eleven requests including unsigned maxima; safe out-of-range and wraparound cursors; zero copies and cursor-alias destinations. Check return counts, original memcpy call arguments, complete state, destination guards and copied bytes. GCC i386 harness passed 92,235 in-range cases, three safe wrap/out-of-range cases and five cursor-alias cases; original 50-byte span checked directly against Game.exe. Implementation compiled with supplied MSVC2013 at O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: No matching-byte claim; original CRT memcpy is represented by an audited test-only copy callback.
Invalid pointers and overlapping source/destination remain outside memcpy's contract; no validation is added.
Only the assigned callback is recovered; decoder internals and opaque owner fields remain unresolved.
Original ABI and offsets apply to 32-bit targets; native pointer fields expand naturally on 64-bit ports.
